dimension_description: Torque measures rotational push: how strongly a force tries to twist something around an axis. This scale mixes microscopic rotary motors, hand tools, engines, and utility-scale machinery. Many values are representative operating torques rather than immutable constants, so the qualifiers and source notes matter.
